verdict.rationale: The launch system lets you coordinate and start many nodes at once (ros2-docs-6), which is the closest evidence of a 'bulk operation across many items' pattern, and CLI tools list/introspect many topics, nodes or services in one command (ros2-docs-8, ros2-docs-30). However there is no documented bulk-edit/bulk-set capability (e.g., setting parameters, canceling actions, or remapping across many nodes/topics simultaneously) beyond individual per-item CLI invocations. Missing for 10: explicit bulk parameter/service/action operations across many items, batch scripting API for mass operations, and any independent confirmation of this being used at scale.
